Subject: Redwood session — customer story + live demo transitions

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We're confirming the agenda for the LumenHealth spotlight session at HealthTech Summit (Aug 18). Two quick asks: 

1) We'd like a short one-pager that frames the customer story (problem, approach, impact numbers) to hand to attendees and press.
2) In the demo segment (10 minutes), Susan Lee (our Head of Ops) wants the transitions between the case story and the live walkthrough to feel seamless — a clear phrase or slide to bridge the narrative.

Can your team send a polished one-pager + the demo script and the slide you'll use for the transition? BrightStage will cut a 30s b-roll based on that.

Attachments: none included in this email.

Best,
Susan Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
LumenHealth

Hi Susan — glad it was helpful yesterday. We can deliver everything on the timeline. Proposed plan: 

- By Friday (7/31): send a draft one-pager and the demo script with suggested transition script line(s).
- By Mon (8/3): updated session deck (v5) that includes the transition slide and notes for the moderator.
- Final assets to BrightStage for b-roll by Wed (8/5).

Quick confirmation needed from your side: which metric should be the headline on the one-pager — the 37% reduction in response latency or the 22% cost-per-case improvement? We can present both but want one primary callout for the handout.

I'm looping in Tessa for design and Markus to confirm AV/slide timing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: demo script + transition options (attached)

Hi team — attaching a fresh demo script (redwood_demo_script_v2.docx) and a short transition-slides checklist. Highlights: 

- Two transition options included: 
  * Option A (data-led): moderator reads a single line, "Here's how LumenHealth moved from problem to product in 3 steps," then cut to a slide showing the 3-step flow. Total on-stage time: ~12s.
  * Option B (human-led): moderator invites Susan Lee to share the operational challenge for 20s, then Monica or our host picks up for the demo with the line, "Let's show how that problem looks inside the product." Total on-stage time: ~18s but higher emotional impact.

- Timestamps and slide IDs are annotated for v5 of the deck.

I've also stubbed a one-pager outline in the doc; will convert to PDF after design polish.

Attachments: redwood_demo_script_v2.docx

—Rishi
Product Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Susan Park <susan.park@lumenhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Draft: demo script + transition options (attached)

Thanks — reviewed with Susan Lee and the comms team. A few notes: 

- We prefer Option B (human-led) — it aligns better with our storytelling.
- Headline for the handout should call out the 22% cost-per-case improvement as the primary stat; latency reduction can be the secondary bullet.
- Deck: please make sure Slide 7 (the customer quote slide) includes a 2-line pull quote from our CIO (I pasted a recommended line in comments).

One more ask: can you send the one-pager as a print-ready PDF by end of day Monday (8/3)? BrightStage needs the final PDF for b-roll textures.

Thanks,
Susan
